scopely:5442573008.title: Associate Economy Game Designer
scopely:5442573008.description:
Scopely is looking for an Associate Game Designer to join our new unannounced project in Barcelona, Spain, on a hybrid basis, working 3 days a week from the hub.
 At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. 
 We are in development stages on an ambitious, unannounced, cross-platform Strategy/MMO title, creating a team of talented and passionate game makers to join us on this exciting journey!
 What You Will Do
 We are looking for an Associate Designer that is eager to design, develop, and deliver top quality features and economy models for our new unannounced cross-platform strategy/MMO title. You will write feature design documentation, defining systems that can support a live game model, and balancing economies to scale.
- Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Art, Analytics, LiveOps and QA to bring compelling features from concept to release
- Write and update design specs that contain the right level of detail while staying concise and easy to understand for the whole team
- Drive feature optimizations to maintain gameplay quality, improve balance, and boost player engagement (levels & puzzles, battle pass, weekly and daily challenges, etc.)
- Keep a Design Owner mentality, ensuring designs meet the player’s needs, the franchise strategy and the business goals
- Follow the most recent market trends and best practices to create the best possible designs for our roadmap features, and to bring new ideas to the table
- Work closely with senior-level economy and systems designers to craft world-class gameplay and deliver a balanced play experience
- Define solutions within a defined space and identify high ROI improvement opportunities
- Design for scale: plan for long-term content extensibility and system health
 What We're Looking For
- A deep passion for game systems and mechanics across mobile and PC 
- 0-2 years of experience designing game systems or balancing game economies
- Excellent communication skills, with the ability to gather feedback, align stakeholders, and iterate collaboratively
- Passion for playing and analyzing games across multiple genres and platforms
- Comfortable working independently while thriving in a highly collaborative environment
- Basic understanding of free-to-play monetization mechanics including game balancing and virtual economy management
 Bonus Points 
- Love for strategy games such as 4X or RTS games
- Experience with mobile game systems and design sensibilities

- Get your hands dirty through direct involvement in building and refining novel gameplay experiences focused on resource generation, spending, time gating, and power growth

- Proven experience in F2P systems design and progression modelling
- 8+ years of experience designing systems or economies for live, F2P games (preferably MMO, 4X, or strategy genres)
- Confident people manager and mentor, that is able to grow & nurture talent
- Experience with all aspects of game design discipline: concept, game progression, interface, monetization, and retention
- A proven track record of delivering features that balance player fun, engagement, and monetisation

- Proven track record of leadership in Game UX, with extensive experience designing for complex, deep systems in live-service F2P games (4X or strategy experience highly preferred).

We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
 Monopoly GO! is our casual game and a key franchise that has Scopely’s largest game, enjoyed by millions of players. The team is based in Canada, Europe and the US, and works every day to create captivating new experiences for our players.
 What You Will Do:
 In this Principal UX Design role, you work in close partnership with our product and development teams to create new gameplay experiences for players.
- Own the end-to-end UX strategy and execution for a product area, driving initiatives independently from discovery through implementation
- Identify opportunities to improve the player experience through product thinking, player insights and data
- Lead discovery initiatives to deepen our understanding of player behaviors, motivations and opportunities
- Drive ideation of new concepts, facilitating workshops, brainstorming sessions, conceptual designs and prototypes to validate ideas early

- Contribute to the growth of the UX discipline by sharing knowledge, raising quality standards and helping build a collaborative design culture

- 8+ years of experience designing user experiences for games 
- Proven track record of creating impactful gameplay features with deep expertise in game mechanics, player motivations, progression systems, rewards and player psychology
- Strong product thinking, with the ability to balance player needs, business goals and technical constraints when making design decisions
- Experience independently owning complex product areas and driving work forward
- Expertise creating prototypes to validate ideas, identify risks early and iterate quickly
- Ability to seamlessly move between tactical execution and strategic thinking, ensuring day-to-day design decisions support broader product goals
- Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively, influence decisions through collaboration and build alignment across disciplines
- Highly collaborative designer who proactively shares ideas, seeks feedback and contributes positively to team culture

 At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily. 
 MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.
 What You Will Do 
 In this Principal UX Design role, you work in close partnership with our product and development teams to create new gameplay experiences for players.
- Own the end-to-end UX strategy and execution for a product area, driving initiatives independently from discovery through implementation
- Identify opportunities to improve the player experience through product thinking, player insights and data
- Lead discovery initiatives to deepen our understanding of player behaviors, motivations and opportunities
- Drive ideation of new concepts, facilitating workshops, brainstorming sessions, conceptual designs and prototypes to validate ideas early
- Create innovative player experiences while balancing creativity with product goals, technical constraints and production realities
- Help evolve UX frameworks, principles and design patterns that promote consistency, scalability and high-quality player experiences across the game
- Champion user research as an essential part of the UX process, partnering with Research to identify risks, define learning objectives and translate findings into product decisions
- Deliver high-quality designs, prototypes and documentation that clearly communicate the intended player experience to Product, Engineering and Art
- Build strong cross-functional relationships, proactively driving alignment and helping teams navigate ambiguity to reach the best player-focused solutions
- Contribute to the growth of the UX discipline by sharing knowledge, raising quality standards and helping build a collaborative design culture
 What We’re Looking For 
- 8+ years of experience designing user experiences for games
- Proven track record of creating impactful gameplay features with deep expertise in game mechanics, player motivations, progression systems, rewards and player psychology
- Strong product thinking, with the ability to balance player needs, business goals and technical constraints when making design decisions
- Experience independently owning complex product areas and driving work forward
- Expertise creating prototypes to validate ideas, identify risks early and iterate quickly
- Ability to seamlessly move between tactical execution and strategic thinking, ensuring day-to-day design decisions support broader product goals
- Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively, influence decisions through collaboration and build alignment across disciplines
- Highly collaborative designer who proactively shares ideas, seeks feedback and contributes positively to team culture
- Strong communication, diplomacy and relationship building skills, with the ability to navigate disagreements professionally while keeping player experience at the center of decision making
- Comfortable working in ambiguity, proactively identifying opportunities and taking ownership to move initiatives forward
- Passion for mentoring, raising craft quality and contributing to the continuous improvement of the UX discipline
 Bonus Points 
- Expanded opportunity for candidates with experience directly managing or mentoring UX designers, with the ability to support individual growth while leading by example through strong hands-on design craft
 About Scopely
 Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.
 Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

- Develop new win conditions, objectives, and progression structures that create varied and engaging multiplayer experiences.
- Design and adapt gameplay rules to support different player capabilities, interaction styles, and gameplay strategies.

king:R027772.location: Barcelona, Spain; London, London, United Kingdom; Stockholm, Stockholm County, Sweden
king:R027772.description:
Craft: 
Games Design & Production 
 Job Description: 
 Are you a systems thinker and creative architect? Do you dream of crafting features that connect everything together: where player progress feels meaningful, social interactions spark joy, and every reward motivates another level? 
 We’re looking for a talented and collaborative Senior Game Designer to join the Gameplay team in Candy Crush Saga, shaping the future of our metagame features and systems in one of the most successful live games in the world. You’ll bring deep systems thinking to the features behind progression, competitive events, and social loops that touch millions of players every day. 
 Your role within the Kingdom 
 As a Senior Game Designer, you’ll design and optimize metagame features and systems, such as progression, competitive events, and social loops, that bring structure, meaning, and delight to the player journey and support the team’s key strategic bets. You’ll own these features and systems end to end, from strategic framing and prototyping through implementation, live release, and iteration, and you’ll be able to explain not just what a feature does but why its specific values, pacing, and reward structure are the right solution. 
 You’ll collaborate closely with product managers, UX designers, engineers, and other game designers to define, prototype, and deliver features and systems that are easy to use, deeply satisfying, and seamlessly connected to the core game. 
 Key Responsibilities 
- Design and evolve metagame features and systems , such as progression, competitive events, and social loops, that deepen engagement and reflect a strong understanding of player behavior and motivation. 
- Own metagame features, systems, and strategic bets end-to-end , from concept and specification through implementation, live release, and iteration. 
- Use quantitative and qualitative data and player insights to inform, balance, and tune features and systems against key metrics. 
- Translate strategic goals, KPIs, and player insights into clear, structured, and actionable design documentation, explaining why specific values, triggers, and pacing are the right solution. 
- Partner with live ops teams to design and optimize features that maximize live events’ impact and player retention. 
- Collaborate deeply with cross-functional teams (product, UX, engineering, data) to deliver high-quality, fun, and impactful experiences. 
- Work with fellow designers to ensure metagame features and systems integrate cohesively with core gameplay and the wider game ecosystem. 
- Stay informed on F2P trends in monetization and player engagement, and share relevant insights with the team. 
- Bring fresh thinking and genre-leading ideas to the Candy Crush metagame, staying ahead of trends in casual F2P design. 
 Skills 
- Proven Experience in Live F2P Metagame Design (Required): You have hands-on experience designing and running live metagame features and systems, such as progression, achievements, or social mechanics, for casual mobile free-to-play games. You understand the rhythms of live content, player motivation, and what keeps players coming back day after day. 
- Feature Ownership & Strategic Delivery: You’ve owned or significantly contributed to metagame features or systems that drove long-term engagement in live casual games, from strategic framing through live release and iteration. 
- Systems & Economy Thinking : You understand how to design and balance interconnected features and systems, progression, rewards, pacing, and player motivation, and can reason about how a change in one system ripples through the wider economy and player behavior. 
- Data-Driven & Insight-Led: You’re comfortable diving into quantitative and qualitative player data, identifying patterns, and turning insights into meaningful design improvements. 
- Player-Centric Mindset: You design for joy and motivation, and you’re excited to test, learn, and iterate with real player feedback. 
- Collaborative & Structured Communicator: You’re a clear communicator who builds alignment across disciplines and helps teams rally behind great ideas. 
- Craft Leadership & Mentorship: You share learnings with other designers, mentor less experienced colleagues, and help raise the bar for metagame design across the team. 
 Bonus points 
- Experience working on match-3, merge, or social mobile games with large, active live playerbases. 
- Experience designing progression systems, achievements, seasonal structures, or social gameplay loops at scale. 
- Familiarity with economy balancing, live ops systems, or content pipelines. 
- Knowledge of match-3 puzzle mechanics and how core gameplay systems (levels, boosters, board mechanics) connect to metagame and live features. 
 About King 
 With a mission of Making the World Playful, King is a leading interactive entertainment company for the mobile world with more than 20 years of history of delivering some of the world’s most iconic games in the mobile gaming industry, including the world-famous Candy Crush franchise, as well as other mobile titles such as Farm Heroes Saga. Around 200 million people play a King game every month. King, part of Microsoft (NASDAQ: MSFT), has Kingsters in Stockholm, Malmö, London, Barcelona, Berlin, Dublin, San Francisco, New York, Los Angeles and Malta. More information can be found at King.com or by following us on LinkedIn and @lifeatking on Instagram.

Who are we? 
 Tripledot Studios is one of the largest independent mobile games companies in the world. 
 We are a multi-award-winning organisation, with a global 2,500+ strong team across 12 studios. 
 Our expanded portfolio includes some of the biggest titles in mobile gaming, collectively reaching top chart positions around the world and engaging over 25 million daily active users. 
 Tripledot’s guiding principle is that when people love what they do, what they do will be loved by others. 
 We’re building a company we’re proud of. One filled with driven, incredibly smart and detail-orientated people, who LOVE making games. 
 Our ambition is to be the most successful games company in the world, and we’re just getting started. 
 This role will be working at Lion Studios 
Lion Studios is a mobile games publisher that works with mobile developers to get their games discovered by players around the world. Headquartered in San Francisco, Lion Studios’ creative and strategy teams utilize their expertise to help game developers break through the noise and grow their businesses. 
 Since launching in 2018, Lion Studios has driven 90% of its games to the Top 10 in the App Store and Google Play and helped drive 16 games to #1 in the US App Store’s Top Free chart. 
 Role Overview 
 As a Game Designer, you will support our Turkish teams and work on our successful casual puzzle titles. You’ll work closely with external development teams, studio managers, and you'll have the exciting opportunity to ideate, craft, and analyze our existing and future puzzle games, contributing to their success. 
 You’ll thrive here if you’re a versatile game design generalist with a strong interest in level design, comfortable building relationships across multiple teams, and able to balance creative judgement with data-informed decision-making.
 Responsibilities 
- Design engaging & challenging core gameplay loops, player experiences, and monetization strategies.
- Partner with external studios in Turkey throughout the new game development pipeline, from early concepts to playable builds.
- Design new mechanics that enhance depth and progression while fitting seamlessly into the game’s design approach.

angrymob:325.description:
Angry Mob Games is looking for a hands-on Gameplay Designer to help shape the core of our upcoming co-op multiplayer game . This isn’t a “write docs and pass them on” role — you’ll be building, testing, and tweaking gameplay in-engine every day. 
 You’ll work closely with a small, tight-knit team to turn ideas into something players can actually feel. 
 Our goal is simple: Make something that’s instantly fun, highly replayable, and built around a strong core loop — not a pile of features. 
What you’ll do 
- Prototype a lot 
 You’ll take ideas and turn them into playable prototypes fast . Test mechanics, controls, and player interactions, see what works, kill what doesn’t, and push the good stuff further. Your work will steer the game by showing what’s fun, not just talking about it. 
- Design the gameplay

- Bring bold, playable ideas 
 We want inventive, fun, sometimes crazy ideas — but always grounded in playability. We care more about how things feel , the moments they create, and whether players want to jump back in, than about long feature lists. 
- Work closely with the team 
 You’ll collaborate with programmers, artists, and level designers to try things, break things, fix what matters, and keep the game moving forward. 
 What we’re looking for 
- Experience designing and shipping gameplay-driven games 
- Solid Unity experience (coding plus blockouts) 
- Great instincts for what makes mechanics fun, readable, and replayable 
- Ability to go from idea → prototype → iteration → decision 
- Comfortable working directly in-engine and testing your own work 
- Clear, practical communication 
 If you love tight mechanics, clever co-op, and finding fun through play , you’ll fit right in. 
 We are open to artists working Remotely or on a Hybrid basis, in Barcelona. 
 To apply, please fill in this form, with a link to your previous work.

userwise:0853FED995.location: Serbia, Romania, Turkey, Poland, Spain, Portugal
userwise:0853FED995.description:
The Opportunity
 UserWise is looking for an experienced Lead UI/UX Designer to own the UI/UX discipline for a a mobile Free-to-Play game based on a globally recognized entertainment IP.
 This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who can translate game and product designs into clear flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes before significant art or engineering work begins. You will stay ahead of production, validate interactions early, identify usability problems before they become expensive production problems, and follow features through implementation to ensure the intended player experience survives into the final game.
 You will also mentor and work alongside an existing UI/UX Designer, helping establish stronger UX processes, patterns, and quality standards across the project.
 This is not a management-only role. We are looking for someone who is comfortable getting directly into the work — mapping flows, wireframing screens, building prototypes, iterating on UI, reviewing builds, and solving problems alongside Game Design, Art, Product, Engineering, and Production.
 What You’ll Do
- Own the overall UX quality and UI/UX discipline across the game.
- Translate game and product concepts into clear user journeys, flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes.
- Stay ahead of production by resolving major interaction and usability questions before features move into Art and Engineering.
- Rapidly prototype and compare UX solutions before committing significant production time.
- Own information architecture, navigation, screen hierarchy, interaction patterns, usability, and player comprehension.
- Design intuitive experiences for gameplay, progression, onboarding, rewards, LiveOps, social features, and monetization.
- Proactively identify UX problems through design reviews, prototypes, and playable builds.
- Follow features through implementation and work with Engineering to preserve design intent.
- Improve the Game Design → UX → Art → Engineering workflow so features move through production with clearer intent and fewer late-stage redesigns.
- Establish reusable UX patterns, UI components, interaction standards, and documentation.
- Mentor and work in parallel with another UI/UX Designer while remaining directly involved in execution.
- Partner closely with the Art Director to define and evolve the visual language of the UI, translating the game’s overall art direction into a cohesive, scalable interface system.
 What We’re Looking For
- Senior or Lead-level experience designing UI/UX for shipped games.
- Strong shipped experience with mobile Free-to-Play games , ideally casual or mass-market titles.
- A portfolio demonstrating both UX thinking and finished game experiences , not just polished UI screens.
- Strong ability to turn complex game systems into simple, intuitive player experiences.
- Excellent understanding of mobile interaction design, information architecture, hierarchy, readability, feedback, and usability.
- Experience designing F2P systems such as progression, rewards, FTUE, events, LiveOps, and monetization.
- Strong wireframing and interactive prototyping skills.
- Strong proficiency with Figma or equivalent modern product-design tools.
- Strong UI design fundamentals and the ability to take work beyond low-fidelity UX when needed.
- Strong product judgment and a proactive approach to identifying and solving experience problems.
- Experience mentoring or providing design direction to other UI/UX Designers.
- Experience collaborating closely with Game Designers, Artists, Engineers, Product Managers, and Producers throughout feature development.
- Familiarity with Unity-based game production is highly valuable.
- Comfort using AI-assisted or rapid-prototyping tools to explore and validate design solutions faster is a plus.
 Portfolio
 A strong portfolio is essential for this role.
 We are particularly interested in examples that demonstrate:
- Shipped mobile and F2P game experiences
- User flows, wireframes, and interactive prototypes
- Evolution from early UX concepts to final shipped UI
- Gameplay, onboarding, progression, rewards, LiveOps, or monetization UX
- Examples where you simplified a complex feature or solved a meaningful usability problem
- Your individual contribution versus the work of the broader team
 Case studies showing how you arrived at a solution are especially valuable. We want to understand the problem, the alternatives you explored, the decisions you made, and how the experience evolved through implementation.

Vira Games - незалежна ігрова компанія, що спеціалізується на розробці та видавництві мобільних ігор. Наша команда - це творчий альянс, що об’єднує досвід, креативність, драйвовість та професіоналізм. 
Ми шукаємо системного економіста, який візьме на себе управління балансом нашої F2P-гри. Ваше головне завдання — зробити так, щоб гра була захопливою для гравців і водночас прибутковою для бізнесу. Ви не просто працюватимете з цифрами в таблицях, а проєктуватимете системну архітектуру економіки: створюватимете дефіцит ресурсів, готуватимете технічні завдання для програмістів і будуватимете надійну логіку економіки, усуваючи потенційні вразливості ще до релізу.
 Основні обовʼязки:
- Баланс економіки: Налаштування отримання та витрат усіх видів ресурсів. Контроль цінності ігрових валют від Tutorial до Late Game.
- Дизайн прогресії: розрахунок досвіду, налаштування темпу гри та тривалості ігрових сесій. Контроль лімітів і створення мотивації регулярно повертатися до гри.
- Монетизація: Налаштування єдиної економіки. Балансування цін для гібридної моделі IAP + Ads.
- Технічний геймдизайн: написання Production-ready GDD для розробників із зазначенням лімітів, форматів даних та вимог до аналітики.
- Аудит: ведення єдиної бази знань з економіки проєкту.
- Пошук і усунення вразливостей у логіці та балансі гри.
- Побудова та підтримка живих економічних моделей: формули прогресії, криві складності, симуляції.
- Баланс ШІ.
- Аналіз даних плейтестів і поведінкових метрик, пошук дисбалансу; обґрунтування кожного рішення числами.
- Написання production-ready документації для розробників (ліміти, формати даних, вимоги до аналітики).
- Кооперація з геймдизайном, розробкою та аналітикою; реалізація в межах віжену геймдизайнера; пропозиції щодо покращень.
 Вимоги: 
- Досвід від 3 років роботи економістом у мобільних F2P-іграх, досвід налаштування Core- та Meta-циклів.
- Обов'язковий досвід роботи з іграми на етапі оперування (LiveOps).
- Поглиблене володіння Excel або Google Sheets (складні формули, зведені таблиці, масиви, індекси).
- Вміння будувати математичні моделі, які легко читати, підтримувати та змінювати.
- Розуміння теорії ймовірностей (Gacha, шанси випадіння предметів), комбінаторики та принципів розрахунку кривих прогресії.
- Розуміння метрик утримання (Retention, Session Length) і монетизації (LTV, ARPDAU, Conversion Rate), а також того, як баланс впливає на поведінку гравця.
- Знання SQL для самостійного отримання та аналізу даних.
 Додаткові вимоги : 
- AI-Native Workflow: AI для вас — не просто чати та промпти, а інструмент, що багаторазово прискорює роботу. Ви готові до стандартів індустрії, вільно використовуєте нейромережі для симуляції тисяч ігрових сесій, генерації Python-коду для розрахунків балансу та як повноцінного ко-пілота під час написання ТЗ.
- Просунуті навички Python (Pandas/NumPy) для складних розрахунків. Досвід візуального моделювання систем. Просунуте володіння SQL для складної аналітики.
- Навичка прорахувати, чи матиме гравець надлишок або нестачу ігрової валюти через пів року гри (LTV 180+), ще на етапі задуму нової фічі.
 Передбачувані етапи інтервʼю:
- Інтервʼю з рекрутером
- Тестове завдання (опціонально)
- Інтервʼю з наймаючим менеджером
- Збір рекомендацій
- Офер

 Remote First: Працюй з будь-якої точки світу віддалена робота є стандартом, а не винятком.
 Вплив на бізнес: Мінімум бюрократії, максимум свободи дій і можливість втілювати свої ідеї.
 Career Boost: Розвиток професійної експертизи, навчання, внутрішні тренінги, стратегічні сесії.
 Culture Driver: Атмосфера єдиної команди, де успіх - результат спільної праці.
